AI Overview
Songless is a free, browser-based music trivia game where you identify a song or artist from a very short audio clip. 
Lessgames
 +1
How to Play
Listen to the snippet: Each round starts with a tiny fraction of a song, often as short as 0.1 seconds. 
Make a guess: Type your guess or select the track from the autocomplete search list. 
Unlock more audio: Every wrong guess or skipped turn reveals a longer segment of the intro. 
Modes available: Choose between the Daily Challenge with a shared worldwide track, Songless Unlimited for continuous play, or multiplayer and genre-specific filters.
